nodes.title: SG-6.3.2 · App remount restores history and Inventory unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: ObjectOverlay renders only when uiStore.canvasLayout is set, and names action buttons '<Action> <Object>'. The App tests in game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx for the remount case ('App remount restores history and Inventory') and the Bookshelf menu and Search cases do not set up the canvas layout or reset uiStore, so the object menu is missing or depends on state leaked from earlier describes. Desired behavior: the tests set up the layout themselves and pass in isolation. Expected result: tests green, no source change to the player experience. Why: SG-6.3 split must keep the same rendered output.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the game view, when Bookshelf is clicked, then Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons appear
- Given the Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked, then history shows the hidden door text
- Given a played game is unmounted and the App remounts, when Begin is clicked, then history and the Inventory region are restored


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx remount and Bookshelf tests
- In scope: confirming ObjectOverlay and GameScreen wiring they rely on
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: api/client.ts
- Out of scope: new features or art
- Preserve: rendered output of App, GameScreen, ObjectOverlay
- Preserve: API client calls and payloads
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports game/frontend
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- The three acceptance criteria are asserted by passing unit tests
- Typecheck passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Bookshelf menu and Search App tests use a canvas layout and real button names
nodes.body:
ObjectOverlay returns null without canvasLayout and labels buttons '<Action> <Object>'. The 'Bookshelf menu buttons' and 'Search shows hidden door' tests must publish a layout and query those names. SG-6.3.1 already fixed this in tests/appFlow.test.tsx; app.test.tsx playing-view tests must also pass in isolation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the game view, when objectClick bookshelf is emitted, then buttons named 'Inspect Bookshelf', 'Push Bookshelf', 'Search Bookshelf' and 'Leave Bookshelf' appear
- Given the Bookshelf menu, when 'Search Bookshelf' is clicked, then the text 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.' is shown


## Scope
- In scope: app.test.tsx App playing view describe
- Out of scope: ObjectOverlay behaviour changes
- Preserve: button naming in ObjectOverlay


## Technical constraints
- Tests mock only what is external
- No test deleted or skipped


## Definition of done
- Both tests pass alone and with the file

- None

nodes.title: REQ · Remounted App restores history and Inventory in the remount test
nodes.body:
The 'App remount and saved state' describe has no beforeEach, so the Bookshelf overlay only appears if canvasLayout leaked from an earlier describe. It must reset uiStore and call setCanvasLayout so Search is clickable, then assert history and the Inventory region after unmount and remount.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a played game is unmounted, when the App remounts and Begin is clicked, then the Story history contains the hidden door text
- Given the remounted App, then the Inventory region is present
- The remount test passes when run alone with a name filter


## Scope
- In scope: app.test.tsx App remount describe
- Out of scope: persistence format changes
- Preserve: runtime/storage readSaved/writeSaved behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- No test deleted or skipped


## Definition of done
- Remount test passes in isolation


## Clarifying questions
- None
